description: This file defines the SortOption interface used for specifying sorting options in search results within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package. It includes methods for creating, modifying, and representing sort options, as well as retrieving their entries and size.

classes.name: SortOption
classes.description: An interface representing a sorting option for search results, supporting creation, modification, and string representation of sort criteria.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SortOption instance from a list of entries.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of the sort entries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new sort entry with specified property path and order, returning a new SortOption.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a provided SortOptionEntry, returning a new SortOption.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of sort entries.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the sort option has no entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential stream of the sort entries.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the sort option, e.g., 'sort(+thingId,-attributes/manufacturer)'.
